turns.reply: Built the Lagos Coders G$ tip jar: a TipJar contract that forwards every tip straight to the club wallet (one-transaction G$ transferAndCall or approve-then-tip), keeps the last tips with their messages and the top ten tippers, plus a landing page and Tip, Leaderboard and About/FAQ pages with amount chips, balance hint and live stats. At deploy you'll be asked for the G$ token address (GoodBuild fills it in) and a treasury address — leave that empty and tips go to the deployer's wallet. Messages are capped at 140 characters and stored publicly on-chain, so the form notes that.
